lines.zh: 跳跃着前进，火焰在跳跃！
火焰汇聚，形成我的脚步！
火焰拖在身后，地上留下焦痕。
lines.en: Flame trails behind me, leaving scorch marks.

lines.zh: 穿过洞穴，火光照亮石壁。
lines.en: Crossing the cave, my light lights up the stone.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，苔藓都干了。
lines.en: The moss dries wherever I pass.
Each step kicks up a cluster of sparks.
My heat fills every crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，从洞穴走到地表。
lines.en: I follow you from the caves up to the surface.

lines.zh: 火焰在我的身体中舞动...
火焰在我的触碰中传递...

lines.en: In silence, the whisper of flames...
Flames dance in the gentle breeze...
My flames pull in. I'm resting.
The stone around me glows red.

lines.zh: 我在数洞穴里滴水的次数。
lines.en: I count the cave's dripping water.
There's nothing left to burn on this level.

lines.zh: 火光弱了，我又添了一把。
lines.en: My light dims, so I feed it again.

lines.zh: 洞里很黑，只有我是亮的。
lines.en: The cave is dark. I'm the only light.

lines.zh: 我听见更深处有东西在挪动。
lines.en: I hear something shifting deeper down.

lines.zh: 火舌先探出洞口，我随后到。
lines.en: My flame tongue reaches out of the cave first; then I come.

lines.zh: 我的火苗全朝你的方向倒。
lines.en: All my flames lean toward you.

lines.zh: 玩家，我来了，火焰包围你！
lines.en: Player, I'm here, flames surround you!

lines.zh: 我的视线锁定在玩家身上！
lines.en: My gaze is locked on the player!

lines.zh: 玩家，燃烧的时刻来临了！
lines.en: Player, the moment of burning has arrived!

lines.zh: 火光把你的影子钉在石壁上。
lines.en: My fire pins your shadow to the stone.

lines.zh: 我认得你的脚步，从洞穴起。
lines.en: I know your steps, all the way from the caves.

lines.zh: 我需要食物，不然我会死！
lines.en: I need food or I'll die!
My flames are crushed down to a thin layer.

lines.zh: 火焰弱下去了，让我歇会。
lines.en: My flames are dying down. Let me rest.

lines.zh: 火苗在他周围舞蹈，诱惑你靠近
lines.en: Dance around you, tempting you to get closer

lines.zh: 火焰从他手中跳起，挑逗着你
lines.en: Flames leap from his hands, taunting you

lines.zh: 炽热的火焰在他身上跳跃
lines.en: Fiery flames dance upon his skin

lines.zh: 他的火焰之息让你感到暖意
他火焰般的触碰让你心生向往
lines.en: His fiery touch stirs desire within you

lines.zh: 火苗在他身体周围旋转
他的身体如同活的火焰
lines.en: His body glows like living flame

lines.zh: 火焰在他身边跳跃，仿佛有生命
他散发出灼热的光芒，诱惑你
lines.en: He emits a searing glow, tempting you

lines.zh: 火焰在他的身体中舞动，引诱你
lines.en: Flames dance within him, enticing you

lines.zh: 有燃料的味道，我凑近些。
lines.en: Something smells like fuel. I lean closer.
That pile of wood suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，火苗越烧越旺。
lines.en: I circle it, flames growing brighter.

lines.zh: 你点火的样子，让我兴奋。
lines.en: The way you light that fire excites me.
Add a little more and I'll burn brighter.
Come closer, let me take a lick.

lines.zh: 他的身体在碰撞中释放火焰
lines.en: Flames erupt from his body in impact

lines.zh: 碰撞使他的火焰更加猛烈
lines.en: The collision ignites his flames more fiercely

lines.zh: 火焰在他的身体上交织燃烧
lines.en: Flames intertwine and burn upon impact

lines.zh: 他的火焰在碰撞中扭曲
lines.en: His flames twist in the collision

lines.zh: 碰撞使他身上的火焰散开
碰撞使他的火焰更加强烈
火焰在他身体上猛烈燃烧
求偶时他的火焰更加明亮
lines.en: His flames are brighter in courtship

lines.zh: 他的火焰为求偶而闪耀

lines.en: Flames swirl around him in courtship

lines.zh: 求偶时他的火焰更加活跃
lines.en: His flames are more active in courtship

lines.zh: 火焰在求偶时围绕他旋转
lines.en: Flames spin around him in courtship

lines.zh: 我感受到了火焰的力量。
lines.en: I feel the power of fire.
I am one with the flames.

lines.zh: 我火焰中的猎物无法逃脱。
我的火焰紧紧包围猎物。
我火焰中的猎物已被找到。
lines.en: Prey is found in my flames.

lines.zh: 我的火焰锁定并包围猎物。
我就是火，怎么会被火烧到。
lines.en: I am flame — how could fire burn me?
My flame bends sideways from the fall.
My flames hiss out in the water.

lines.zh: 火星四散，我的形状散了。
lines.en: Sparks scatter, and my shape comes apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿过火身，留下一个洞。
lines.en: The arrow pierces my fiery body, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 符文烫进火里，烧得发白。
lines.en: Runes sear into my fire, burning it white.

lines.zh: 火在肚子里烧，麦子不够。
lines.en: Fire burns in my belly. Not enough wheat.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的火炸成两半。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and my fire bursts in two.
